fields.description: The mapped doctype's id_field value for the record this row tracks -- not a Link, since the mapped doctype varies per mapping.
fields.label: Record ID

fields.description: Which doctype field this row tracks. One row per (mapping, record, field) -- conflict detection is per-field, not per-record, since two fields on the same record can independently be edited on either side without colliding.
fields.label: Field

fields.description: The value both sides agreed on as of the last successful sync (whichever direction wrote it last) -- the baseline conflict detection diffs the CURRENT Frappe value and CURRENT Sheet value against, to tell "only one side changed" apart from "both sides changed to different values."
fields.label: Last Synced Value

fields.description: Set when this field's value diverged on both sides since the last sync -- see Google Sheets Sync Log for the run that flagged it. Neither side is applied while this is set; an admin must resolve it (edit either side, then clear this flag) before this field syncs again.
fields.label: Conflict Flagged
